resource_metadata.openai/widgetDescription: Option Desk charts with synthetic or user-data labels and explicit units.

review_explanations.readOnlyHint: Generates charts and calculations from SYNTH or a user-supplied snapshot. Does not modify user records, place orders, or change external systems.
review_explanations.openWorldHint: Processes data within the hosted service. Does not fetch live market data, contact external services, or publish user data.
review_explanations.destructiveHint: Does not delete or overwrite user records, change account settings, or execute financial transactions. Temporary analysis files are cleaned up after processing.

note: Annotations and resource metadata were read from the MCP endpoint. Review explanations are prepared submission text, not fields returned by the endpoint.
